question: Which of the following Indian states is famous for the traditional Warli painting style? (RRB Paramedical (13/03/2026) Shift 2)
options: Punjab
Rajasthan
Maharashtra
Kerala
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Maharashtra

Explanation:
Warli painting is a traditional folk art form of Maharashtra, primarily practiced by the tribal communities in the Palghar district. This art form dates back to around 2500 BCE and is characterized by the use of geometric shapes such as circles, triangles, and squares. Natural colors like red ochre, white rice powder, and green leaves are used in Warli paintings. These paintings are typically done on walls and depict scenes of hunting, dancing, farming, and nature. Warli painting received the Geographical Indication (GI) tag in 2011. It is known for its simple yet expressive style that has gained international recognition.

question: Which temple's garbhagriha houses a Chaturmukha (four-faced) Vishnu image? (RRB NTPC GRADUATE CBT 1 (18/03/2026) Shift 1)

Meenakshi Temple, Madurai
Brihadiswara Temple, Thanjavur
Dashavatara Temple, Deogarh
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Lakshmana Temple, Khajuraho

Explanation:
The Lakshmana Temple, located in Khajuraho, Madhya Pradesh, was built by the Chandela dynasty. Its garbhagriha houses a rare Chaturmukha (four-faced) image of Lord Vishnu, showcasing exquisite craftsmanship. The temple is dedicated to Vishnu and is built in the Nagara style of architecture. The other options: Meenakshi Temple in Madurai is a Dravidian-style temple, Brihadiswara Temple in Thanjavur is dedicated to Shiva, and the Dashavatara Temple in Deogarh dates back to the Gupta period and is also Vaishnavite but not with a Chaturmukha image.

question: The widespread use of which architectural features distinguishes Mughal architecture from earlier trabeate temple construction? (RRB NTPC GRADUATE CBT 1 (19/03/2026) Shift 1)
options: Circular stupas and railings
Arches and domes
Wooden beams and flat ceilings
Corbelled roofs and stepped pyramids
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Arches and domes

Explanation:
Mughal architecture is distinguished by its extensive use of arches and domes, unlike earlier trabeate temple construction which relied on horizontal beams placed on columns. The Mughal style introduced true arches and bulbous domes, often made of brick and mortar, and later marble. This technique derived from Persian and Central Asian traditions. Iconic Mughal structures like the Taj Mahal, Red Fort, and Jama Masjid showcase these features.

question: Who was the first Indian to win the Pulitzer Prize? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (07/04/2021) Shift 2)
options: Gobind Behari Lal
Jhumpa Lahiri
Siddhartha Mukherjee
Geeta Anand
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Gobind Behari Lal

Explanation:
Gobind Behari Lal was the first Indian to win the Pulitzer Prize in 1937. He was honored for his reporting series covering advancements in science and technology in India. The Pulitzer Prize is awarded annually for excellence in journalism, literature, and music. Gobind Behari Lal was a renowned journalist and science writer who reported on Indian science news for American newspapers. This award came before India gained independence. His father was also a distinguished academician. Lal later played a key role in promoting science communication in India. His work highlighted the scientific progress in India to the global audience. The Pulitzer Prize is named after journalist Joseph Pulitzer and is one of the most prestigious awards in its fields.

Explanation:
2004 का नोबेल शांति पुरस्कार केन्या की वांगारी मथाई को पर्यावरण संरक्षण, लोकतंत्र और शांति के क्षेत्र में उनके योगदान के लिए दिया गया। वह पूर्वी अफ्रीका की पहली महिला थीं जिन्होंने डॉक्टरेट की उपाधि प्राप्त की और पर्यावरणीय स्थिरता के लिए वैश्विक मंच पर पहचान बनाई। उन्होंने स्वच्छ जल, ऊर्जा और खाद्य सुरक्षा के माध्यम से विकासशील देशों में ग्रामीण महिलाओं को सशक्त बनाने का कार्य किया। मथाई ने ग्रीन बेल्ट मूवमेंट की स्थापना की, जिसके तहत लाखों पेड़ लगाए गए। उनके कार्यों ने वैश्विक स्तर पर पर्यावरण संरक्षण और सतत विकास के महत्व को उजागर किया।
